items.note: The eight-row cancel/introduce/restore schedule, the net change (JV+RG)x, both coefficient checks and the (x,y)->(x,y+x)->(-y,y+x)->(-y,x) chain follow the proof at 741-765 exactly. However, the plan never gives h=100 or the triple-indexed banks, and it calls the three stages 'three invocations'. In the paper each stage acts on one coordinate through v^2 invocations (670-677).

The plan states D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1} and the per-route operator eps_w D_sink(rho(w)) D_source(w)^{-1}, and derives them from the invariant and from commutation of a common frame with a pointwise gate, as at 804-825.

The plan states comparability, the only decrease (center 3->4, loss h), L=Ich, Wm-2N+2L, the F_2 orthonormal bases and both loss ratios. It never names the ambient space F^{(x)3} or its dimension h^3, and it omits the actual label assignment (A, P, B, Q, eq:motif-labels and the residual table), so the counting is shown but the construction behind it is not.

The plan gives Phi_M frames, the permutation rho, endpoint difference I_m on every role, s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b<W_b m, P_U at gates and sinks, and -P_{U_a} at sources with its extra rank-one edge 2P_{U_a}. This matches the proof at 1156-1171.

The plan states the per-edge factorisation into kernels (aI+bX_v)^{+-1}, one per orthonormal residual vector, and s_c<W_c m. It never defines the phase frames C_U=H^{(x)m}diag(i^{q_U})H^{(x)m}, never gives s_c=W_c m-2N+2L_c, and omits the conclusion that, after the diagonal corrections, every role receives C^{(x)m}. The weight-additivity proof is absent.

The plan states L<N/2, the deficit N-2L_b>0, s_c<W_c m, eta_b and eta_c above 20*2^{-50}, log m<20, and hence s/W<m^tau with tau=sigma=1-2^{-50}, following 1331-1344. It omits the exact eta fractions and the complex deficit 2N-2L_c, which the conclusion does not need.
Both lemmas are stated with their O(V) content and the b^{O(1)} offset condition. Neither proof (split/merge on digits, splitting a fibre at Q-a) is given.

Both parts follow the paper. The plan gives the elimination with the topmost-row/rightmost-entry pivot, then the prime choice, triangular updates in descending order, the E_2, E_1^{-1}, Pi D, E_1, E_2^{-1} sequence, and the one-interchange implementation of H_i<-H_i+D_j.

Every step of the proof is present: the k=0 case, the m fields of b=e/m digits, the cyclic row split into W streams, Phi_{A_e} edges via matrix-shear, and the shear on every row including scratch rows. So are the D<-D-H, H<-H+D, D<-H-D interchange, the s calls of volume V/W, the recurrence, the geometric sum and the fixed-tape O(V) parking.

The plan follows the paper: high digits become a row field R=q^{2rho}>=W^k at cost O(V rho), rows are padded to a multiple of W^k, the width is split into base-m pieces summing to O(Ve^tau), and binary ranges are padded to [q^e], giving O(Vu^tau).

The plan has the basis change P_M conjugating kernels onto slots, one forward child per kernel through the (C^{-1})^{(x)f} identity, the row-addition count, s_c children on e/m axes and H_0^{(x)D}=b^D S_D C^{(x)D} S_D. Missing: the recursive contract that the network, after the Z_{a,f} and i^{27f} corrections, returns C^{(x)e} on every role (1907-1913).

The plan follows the paper's route: eight packed rotations, the guard interval, the 80(f-1)2^{-K} union bound, T_0 S_0^{-1} permuting B, radix-sort repair and the separate top bit. The headline cost O(V(L^tau+1)) is stated without the family hypotheses (R superpolynomial, K/log p->infinity) under which the full bound reduces to it.

The plan follows 2286-2447: s calls per node, packed overhead O((eK)^tau+1), q_0 row chunks, the u=Wg+w split with V/W children, the recurrence with leaves O(e), the internal sum O(e^lambda) via K<=e^{c/beta}, the leaf bound e^sigma d^{beta(1-sigma)}, and base-m pieces giving d^{lambda'}.

The plan states Q_p(Hz) in O(Vd^{lambda'}), exact evaluation with Delta=ceil(C_0 d^{C_1})=o(p), A(e)<=sA(e/m)+E and the single truncation with error below sqrt2*2^{-p}. Its derivation follows the guard-width bound and the proof at 2686-2757.

The plan includes character cancellation without division, decimation in frequency into bit-reversed order, the reversed procedure, round grouping, the layout L with its prefix moves and chunk exchanges and their costs, and the single truncation per round. It ends with the exact counterparts LBF^- and F^+B^{-1}L^{-1}.

The plan follows 3233-3367: evaluation at B_0=2^{4p}, four products with the established multiplier, the |h_j|<B_0/2 separation, the carry bounds in packing and extraction, negacyclic reduction, and cost O(rp log(rp)).
The plan gives the retained LB order, P(LBu,LBv)=LBP(u,v), the normalisation identity, the error M(3delta+eta) and the cost including O(Tp log(rp)), all as in the proof.

The one-dimensional identity is obtained through the Neumann inverse of N=CTD, the rescaled maps, the 2^{-2alpha^2} normalisation and C as an ordered selection. The plan then gives the tensor identity, linewise padding, the dp^2 error and the O(dTp^{3/2+delta}alpha+Tpd^2(1+l^tau)) cost, matching the paper.

The plan derives the chirp identity from the period and the coefficient comparison, and the cancellation from F^+R_c=R_c^{-1}F^+ and commutation with pointwise products. It also gives the conjugation trick, exactly as at 3938-3987.

The plan includes the fixed exponents, the size parameters, the axis lengths and the prime-interval estimate with eta=1/(4d). It also gives disjoint intervals, T/2<S<T, alpha^4 theta_i>p, trial-division search in n^{o(1)}, no wraparound and c_j<2^{3b}, all matching 4004-4193.
The plan follows 4204-4292: the isomorphism, the triangular coordinate formula, update order d..1, padded-box rotations, prefix-controlled shifts and O(d^2) axis moves costing O(Tp d^2(1+l^tau)).

The plan states the map x_d->zeta y, its well-definedness, the wrap check zeta^{k+l}(-1)^h=zeta^j, M_C=D_- iota^{-1} M_r(iota D_+ f, iota D_+ g)=(f*g)/T and the twist error below 4h_p, as in the paper.

The plan gives the source transform with its exact counterpart RF_s, F^+ by conjugation, and the six steps with the two S scales. It omits the input scaling of digits by 2^{-b-2} (4495-4498), which is what the factor 2^{2b+4} undoes, so S5.1.11's account of the second scale is incomplete.

The plan follows the error chain E_ring<5TL, 6TL, 8TL, E_s=9*2^gamma TL, then (2E_s+2) and E_w<28*2^gamma T^2 L. It ends with the final bound 448b 2^{-3b/4}<1/2, rounding, carries and the 2n-bit output, as at 4555-4806.

The plan gives the rows and margins g_1..g_7 with min g_2=2^{-181}=2kappa, the setup and exceptional-sort terms as o(V), the log-power slack and the schoolbook cutoff, matching 4808-4995. S6.3's g_1,g_6>1/8 is weaker than the paper's >1/2 but true.
No step discusses the n log n conjecture, eventual lower bounds or the liminf negation. S0 states only the time bound.

errors.says: Three invocations of a fixed schedule of linear gates exchange the two banks X,Y up to sign and restore every scratch wire.
errors.paper: The exchange uses three stages. Stage j acts on coordinate j of a in T^3 through v^2 separate invocations, each with its own scratch wires, so I=3v^2 invocations in all (670-677). The lemma speaks of a forward invocation at stage 1, an inverse at stage 2 and a forward at stage 3 (731-733).

errors.says: Every edge joins comparable nondegenerate labels: the stage transitions are built so that each label contains the previous one.
errors.paper: Edges join comparable labels, but the central-wire edges from time 3 to time 4 decrease: the later label is contained in the earlier one, losing P(x)F(x)Q of dimension h (998-1000, 1061).

errors.says: Adding the selected bits ... costs O(V(L^tau+1)).
errors.paper: The lemma's time is O(V(L^tau+1)+M A_rect^3+delta_bad M A_rect(R+A_rect)). It reduces to O(V(L^tau+1)) only when A_rect=O(p), R exceeds every fixed polynomial in p, f<=d<=p and K/log p->infinity (2001-2010).

errors.says: Each of the l chunk rounds is one simultaneous layer, so they cost O(Tpd^{lambda'}) per round and O(Tp l d^{lambda'}) in total.
errors.paper: Only the qK rounds on the remaining chunks use the simultaneous layer. The at most b+1 rounds on prefix slots, and the leading round on the long axes, are done by individual butterflies. The bound O(Tp l d^{lambda'}) counts at most l rounds (3058-3063, 3103-3104, 3127-3128).

chain: The tree follows the paper's route to the main bound. It builds two tape procedures from a bank-exchange network with s<Wm, then synthetic transforms and convolution, Gaussian resampling with the chirp and permutation cancellation, the CRT map and twist, exact recovery, and the cost table with min margin 2kappa. Nearly every link is derived from the paper's own sub-steps. It thins at the network's foundations: h=100, N=binom(h,3)^3, m=h^3 and the explicit label construction are never given, so the ratios 100/539 and 101/539 have no stated source. The complex interface's endpoint identity (C^{(x)m} on every role) is also missing, so the butterfly recursion's correctness rests only on edge-kernel counts.

steps.note: The exchange (x,y)->(-y,x) with restored scratch is fully reconstructed. The fixed parameters are absent: h=100, banks indexed by a in T^3, N=binom(h,3)^3 and m=h^3 (S2.1.5.1.2 names N and m only as counts). Conservative verdict.
The plan gives a common invertible frame commuting with a pointwise gate, the operator D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1}, and edges that only change frame, in that role.

The plan states nondegenerate labels from triple indicator lines, comparable labels on every edge, and the only decrease at the central wires 3->4 losing h. The ambient space F^{(x)3} is not named (only 'dimension m'), and S2.1.5.1.3 contains a slip about containment.
P_V-P_U has rank dim V-dim U, and the N source edges 2P_{U_a} are the rank-one exceptions.
The plan gives the telescoping to Wm-2N, L=Ich, the absolute sum Wm-2N+2L and s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b.
L/N=100/539 and 101/539, both below 1/2, so the deficit N-2L_b>0 and s<Wm.
The plan gives the endpoint difference P_{U_a^perp}+P_{U_a}=I_m (zero source and identity sink elsewhere), so the shear H<-H+D acts on every role and row.
The plan gives the factorisation E_1 Pi E_2, exactly a interchanges plus O(V), and s recursive calls per node.
Children have volume V/W and F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1). Then s/W<m^tau with tau=1-2^{-50}, from eta>20*2^{-50} and log m<20, and the geometric sum gives O(e^tau).

central.summary: The plan reconstructs the central saving almost entirely, from frames, comparable labels and rank equal to dimension change, through the Wm-2N+2L budget, the L/N<1/2 deficit, the endpoint identity and the recursive calls, to the recurrence with tau=1-2^{-50}. Only the starting network's fixed data (h=100, triple-indexed banks, N=binom(h,3)^3, m=h^3) is missing, so C1 is only mentioned.
